name: smbmap
highlights: --host-file — File containing a list of hosts
-u — Username, if omitted null session assumed
-p — Password or NTLM hash, format is LMHASH:NTHASH
--signing — Check if host has SMB signing disabled, enabled, or required

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: -H
flags.description: IP or FQDN

flags.name: --host-file
flags.description: File containing a list of hosts

flags.name: --username
flags.description: Username, if omitted null session assumed

flags.name: --password
flags.description: Password or NTLM hash, format is LMHASH:NTHASH

flags.name: --prompt
flags.description: Prompt for a password

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Specify a share (default C$), ex 'C$'

flags.name: -d
flags.description: Domain name (default WORKGROUP)

flags.name: -P
flags.description: SMB port (default 445)

flags.name: --version
flags.description: Return the OS version of the remote host

flags.name: --signing
flags.description: Check if host has SMB signing disabled, enabled, or required

flags.name: --admin
flags.description: Just report if the user is an admin

flags.name: --no-banner
flags.description: Removes the banner from the top of the output

flags.name: --no-color
flags.description: Removes the color from output

flags.name: --no-update
flags.description: Removes the "Working on it" message

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: Set port scan socket timeout. Default is .5 seconds

flags.name: --kerberos
flags.description: Use Kerberos authentication

flags.name: --no-pass
flags.description: Use CCache file (export KRB5CCNAME='~/current.ccache')

flags.name: -x
flags.description: Execute a command ex. 'ipconfig /all'

flags.name: --mode
flags.description: Set the execution method, wmi or psexec, default wmi

flags.name: -L
flags.description: List all drives on the specified host, requires ADMIN rights.

flags.name: -r
flags.description: Recursively list dirs and files (no share\path lists the root of ALL shares), ex. 'email/backup'

flags.name: -g
flags.description: Output to a file in a grep friendly format, used with -r (otherwise it outputs nothing), ex -g grep_out.txt

flags.name: --csv
flags.description: Output to a CSV file, ex --csv shares.csv

flags.name: --dir-only
flags.description: List only directories, ommit files.

flags.name: --no-write-check
flags.description: Skip check to see if drive grants WRITE access.

flags.name: -q
flags.description: Quiet verbose output. Only shows shares you have READ or WRITE on, and suppresses file listing when performing a search (-A).

flags.name: --depth
flags.description: Traverse a directory tree to a specific depth. Default is 1 (root node).

flags.name: -A
flags.description: Define a file name pattern (regex) that auto downloads a file on a match (requires -r), not case sensitive, ex '(web|global).(asax|config)'

flags.name: -F
flags.description: File content search, -F '[Pp]assword' (requires admin access to execute commands, and PowerShell on victim host)

flags.name: --search-path
flags.description: Specify drive/path to search (used with -F, default C:\Users), ex 'D:\HR\'

flags.name: --search-timeout
flags.description: Specifcy a timeout (in seconds) before the file search job gets killed. Default is 300 seconds.

flags.name: --download
flags.description: Download a file from the remote system, ex.'C$\temp\passwords.txt'

flags.name: --skip
flags.description: Skip delete file confirmation prompt

examples.explanation: Enumerate hosts with NULL sessions enabled and open shares
Display SMB shares and permissions on a [H]ost, prompting for user's password or NTLM hash
Execute a shell command on a remote system
Enumerate hosts and check SMB file permissions
Connect to an ip or hostname through smb using a username and password
